messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — planning a gentle route-weight squeeze from eu-west -> apac tonight at 22:30 UTC. Aim: bump apac by 8% for 2h to warm caches and exercise fallback. Steps below.

kai: I'll be on deploy. timeline ok for me.

tess: ETA ok, I'll own smoke checks and log watch.

morgan: Thanks. Rollout plan: +2% every 8m across edge pools, health check after each step. If 5xx rate >0.5% or p95 latency regresses >150ms we stop and rollback. Will use routing-api to change weights.

ryan: Which route names? and DNS TTL expectations?

morgan: routes: `inference-eu` -> `inference-apac`. DNS TTL unchanged (60s) — we'll do pure routing weight adjustments, not DNS swaps.

kai: Deploy command (run from utils box):
```
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/weights \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"route":"inference","changes":[{"region":"apac","delta":2}] }'
```
I'll run that every 8m until +8% reached. I'll post status after each step.

tess: Smoke checklist (I'll run after each step):
- curl /health on 10 random nodes
- run 50 qps synthetic to /v1/generate with sample prompt
- check errors>0 and p95 in the last 5m

morgan: Rollback command (if needed):
```
# rollback to previous weights snapshot
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/weights/rollback \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"snapshot_id":"latest-before-squeeze"}'
```

ryan: I'll notify support & on-call and open a short incident channel if we need to pause.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by morgan at 1766667777, id=roll-20260909-001 :rocket:

tess: First step executed +2% — no visible regressions. p95 steady. continuing.

kai: +4% done.

tess: +6% executed, minor error spike (0.2%) on a single proxy, mitigated by warming cache. monitoring OK.

morgan: +8% final step complete. We'll hold for 2h then ramp back if everything stable. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Notified support rotation and created ticket INF-ROLLUP-348.
